Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@medicore.com>

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — POC environment details

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Priya and I put together what we need to validate performance and security in our initial POC. Attached is our network requirements doc (medicore_network_requirements.pdf). High level asks:

- Org/tenant created in Redwood test plane for Medicore (separate from production).
- Short-lived API keys for the staging workload (non-prod) with usage caps.
- IP allowlist: we will provide a set of egress CIDRs and need Redwood’s inference endpoints opened.
- VPC peering request for low-latency data transfers (AWS, us-east-1).

Can you confirm what info you need from our infra team to get the MAP updated and the environment provisioned? We’d like a mutual action plan with dates for each item — keys, org setup, allowlist, peering — and a target close no later than 2028-02-10.

Thanks,
Evan

Attachment: medicore_network_requirements.pdf (pdf)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Evan Li <evan.li@medicore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jan 2028 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — POC environment details

Evan — thanks, received the network doc. I’ve handwritten a short MAP draft and attached an initial spreadsheet (map-draft.xlsx) with proposed owners and target dates. Quick answers up front:

- Org setup: we can spin up a dedicated org in our staging tenant. We need Medicore’s billing org name, legal contact, and a primary admin (email) to accept org invite.
- API keys: we’ll issue scoped, expiring keys for staging. Default TTL 30 days; can shorten if you prefer.
- IP allowlist: Redwood needs the public IP ranges (CIDR blocks) you’ll egress from. We can apply a per-model endpoint allowlist or a broader account-level allowlist — recommend endpoint-level for least blast radius.
- VPC peering: we support AWS VPC peering in us-east-1. Required fields: AWS account ID, VPC ID, VPC CIDR, and the desired peering type (direct peer for private endpoints). We’ll coordinate a short maintenance window for the peering acceptance.

Next step proposal (high level):
1) Today (Jan 25): Medicore provides billing org name, admin email, AWS account ID + VPC details, and IP CIDRs.
2) Jan 26: Redwood creates Medicore staging org + issues initial API keys (30d TTL).
3) Jan 27–28: IP allowlist applied, endpoint smoke tests.
4) Jan 30: VPC peering request created; Medicore accepts and we validate routing.
5) Feb 1–3: Workload run, latency/cost checks; iterate.

If those dates work, we’ll stamp the MAP and create a shared calendar invite for the handoffs. Jon (cc’d) will own peering coordination; Neha will own org+billing onboarding; Marissa will be primary for MAP milestones.

Hannah

I’ll start the peering request as soon as we have the AWS account + VPC fields.

—Jon
